notice: This catalog lists verified information sources. It does not provide unsigned firmware or claim that a custom ROM is supported.

entries.title: Official HONOR X8b software update
entries.description: The phone checks for updates signed and offered for its exact region and current build. No universal full firmware package is published on this support page.

entries.title: How HONOR online system updates work
entries.description: HONOR documents checking for updates in Settings > System & updates > Software update. Availability varies by model, region and rollout.

entries.title: Custom ROM compatibility tracker
entries.description: Search by the exact model code. Do not install a ROM for another HONOR model or another X8b regional variant. A listing alone is not proof that a build is safe or installable.
